title: Nilinywa sake huko Tenma, Osaka, nikasinzia barabarani na kupoteza kiatu kimoja
label: Kiatu kilichopotea

text.The place where I failed big with alcoho: Kosa langu kubwa kutokana na pombe lilitokea Tenma, Osaka.
text.Tenma is an area with so many izakaya ba: Tenma ni eneo lenye baa nyingi sana za izakaya.
Pia kuna sehemu nyingi za bei nafuu.
text.There, I once went out to eat with a fri: Wakati mmoja nilitoka kula huko na rafiki yangu anayeishi Osaka.
text.I was that drunk, and I slept somewhere: Nilikuwa nimelewa kiasi cha kulala mahali nisipopajua hata kidogo.
text.From that day, I became scared of alcoho: Tangu siku hiyo, nilianza kuiogopa pombe.
text.Thank You: Shukrani kwa rafiki yangu na usalama wa Japani
Lakini rafiki yangu alikuwa mtu mwema sana.
text.It seems I fell asleep on the street, bu: Inaonekana nililala barabarani, lakini rafiki yangu alinipelekea nyumbani begi langu na vitu vingine vya thamani.
Kwa hiyo vitu vyangu muhimu havikuibiwa.
Pia nilifikiri kwamba Japani ni salama kweli.
text.My smartphone was in my pocket, and it w: Simu yangu ilikuwa mfukoni na haikuibiwa hata kidogo.
text.When I woke up, I still had my smartphon: Nilipoamka bado nilikuwa na simu yangu, kwa hiyo kwa namna fulani nilifanikiwa kurudi nyumbani.
text.I am really glad I passed out drunk in O: Ninafurahi sana kwamba nilizimia kwa ulevi Osaka—yaani, Japani.
Nilishukuru sana kwa jinsi Japani ilivyo salama.
text.Japanese sake is a time bomb: you feel f: Sake ya Kijapani ni bomu la muda: mwanzoni unajisikia sawa, kisha inakupiga baadaye
text.At Shinjuku Station, even I, a Japanese: Hata mimi nikiwa Mjapani hupotea katika Kituo cha Shinjuku
